groups.empty.title: No groups yet
groups.empty.body: Create one on a computer you have connected, with the people and AIs who work together.
groups.empty.offline: No computer of yours is connected yet. A group lives on one of them.
groups.waiting.lead: Everything across your groups that cannot move until you act.
groups.waiting.none.body: When an AI needs your approval, your decision or your go-ahead, it shows up here.
groups.create.lead: The computer you choose becomes the group's home: it keeps the group's messages, so it has to stay on.
groups.create.name: Group name
groups.create.people.lead: People in your other groups on this computer: tick them to add them directly, with no code and no link.
groups.create.people.none: Nobody else is in your groups on this computer yet.
groups.create.people.hint: Anyone else can join by an invitation code or link once the group exists.
groups.create.ais.need: A working group needs 3 AIs: 1 secretary + at least 2 working AIs (so the assignee and reviewer of a task are different AIs). You can mix two CLIs, or add the same CLI twice with different AI names and folders using Add AI after creating the group.
groups.create.ais.none: No AI is connected yet. Connect a computer and choose an account type for its AI on the Computers page.
groups.create.ai.name: Name of {ai} in the group
groups.create.partly: The group exists, but not everyone could be added. Add them again from its member panel.
groups.create.unsent: Not sent: an earlier step was refused
groups.create.names: Two members cannot have one name: change one of the names.
groups.create.person.error.not_found: Not in any of your groups on this computer any more: invite them by code or link.
groups.create.person.error.conflict: Already in the group, or the name is taken.
groups.missing: This group has not been read yet. It is read once the computer that is its home can be reached.
